'''SOC CC Troopers''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list [[SOC]] published on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]].<ref name="or">[http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/balancedecks/15dark.htm CC Troopers], The Outer Rim (SOC). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20091027155335/http://geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/balancedecks/15dark.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[SOC]]
* '''Published:''' by 12 May 2001 (The Outer Rim)
* '''Published title:''' ''CC Troopers''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Cloud City: Downtown Plaza|SE-D-cloudcitydowntownplaza.gif}}

== Introduction ==

SOC posted this Cloud City trooper list on The Outer Rim as CC Troopers. The published list has 57 cards.
